description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This confidential role is critical for a recently acquired facility, offering a unique chance to significantly impact its growth and community presence. We are seeking a visionary leader who is eager to drive marketing initiatives and elevate the facility's reputation.The ideal candidate will be highly presentable, possess a strong work ethic, and be prepared to work occasional weekends as needed to achieve marketing objectives. We are looking for a 'hustler' – someone with relentless drive and initiative to identify and capitalize on market opportunities. This role offers significant potential for a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.Join a team dedicated to providing outstanding care and make your mark in a facility poised for success. This is an urgent and highly valued position for a candidate ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a healthcare or skilled nursing facility setting
Demonstrated ability to be presentable and maintain a professional demeanor
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as business needs dictate
A 'hustler' mentality with a strong track record of initiative and achieving marketing goals
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive and will be well-paid for the right candidate, based on experience.
